title: Exponential mixing for the stochastic Navier--Stokes equation with localized noise
summary: This paper studies the 2D Navier--Stokes equation on a bounded domain with Navier-slip boundary conditions, driven by spatially localized stationary forcing generated by a stochastic heat equation. We prove exponential mixing for the associated Navier--Stokes--heat system, and consequently exponential convergence of the velocity law under stationary forcing. The main difficulty is that the white noise is confined to a subdomain and reaches the velocity indirectly through the heat component.
